meta.description: View, query, and interpret VCF/BCF variant files with bcftools and cyvcf2. Use when inspecting variants, extracting fields with query format strings, converting VCF/BCF, or correctly reading a field -- QUAL vs GQ vs PL/GL, AD vs DP and allele balance, GT phasing/ploidy/PS and missing-vs-hom-ref, INFO/FORMAT Number A/R/G semantics, symbolic alleles and END, or telling a raw gVCF apart from a filtered callset.
meta.execution_note: Mode A. bcftools 1.24 (MSYS2 native Windows build) for CLI steps; cyvcf2 0.34.0 (bioconda, micromamba env in the WSL 'agents' distro, /tmp) for all Python, including the shipped examples/view_vcf.py. All data SYNTHETIC (data/make_data.py, seed 20260911): 1-sample callerA.vcf, 8-sample raw cohort.vcf (SYN_S6 low-coverage, SYN_S7 contaminated, SYN_S8 duplicate of S3), sample.g.vcf. Inputs executed: 5/5. Layer-1 avg 37.4/40, Layer-2 avg 53.4/60, assertion pass rate 18/20 (90%).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; the three references (VCFtools 2011, BCFtools 2021, hts-specs) are real and correctly described.

practice_boundaries.detail: File inspection only; no individual-level interpretation.

methodological_ground.detail: Field semantics verified: GQ equals min(99, second-smallest PL) on 2812/2812 genotypes; cyvcf2 gt_types codes and missing-vs-hom-ref handling correct.

code_usability.detail: All bcftools and cyvcf2 blocks ran unmodified (paths only); shipped examples/view_vcf.py ran.

functional_suitability.note: Complete coverage of view/query/convert and field semantics; claims checked against data (PL/GQ, Number codes, gt_types). One wrong tip in usage-guide.md: 'Use -H with bcftools query to skip the header line' (for query, -H prints a header; SKILL.md itself is right).

reliability.note: Common Errors table maps real failures to fixes; the bgzip row quotes 'no BGZF EOF marker' while bcftools 1.24 prints 'not compressed with bgzip' / 'not BGZF compressed, cannot index'.

performance_context.note: 263-line SKILL.md; dense but every section is used.

agent_usability.note: Governing principle (level + Number before meaning) is exactly what an agent needs; strong traps list (./. vs 0/0, *, <NON_REF>, PS). Minor usage-guide/SKILL.md inconsistency on query -H.

human_usability.note: Plain-language prompts in the usage guide map to the sections.

maintainability.note: Small runnable example; no test data shipped.

agent_specific.note: Clear trigger and routing to normalization/joint-calling; idempotent read-only operations.

inputs.label: Inspect header, samples, table and type counts
inputs.note: Header lines, sample list, GT/GQ/AD table and SNP/indel counts (8/3) produced; shipped view_vcf.py ran. SKILL.md shows query -H as a column header (correct); usage-guide tip says the opposite.

assertions.text: Header, samples and a per-sample field table are produced with the Skill's commands
SNP/indel counts are correct
The shipped example runs as written
Guidance on bcftools query -H is consistent across the Skill
assertions.note: usage-guide says -H skips the header; it prints '#[1]CHROM ...'

inputs.execution_note: runs/in1/run.sh (bcftools 1.24) and view_vcf.upstream_copy.py (upstream LF bytes via git show, cyvcf2 0.34 in WSL).

inputs.label: Allele balance from AD and QUAL vs GQ
inputs.note: Per-sample het AB computed from AD; SYN_S7 stands out (mean 0.419, 16% of hets outside 0.2-0.8 vs <=10% for others); all 8 high-QUAL sites with a low-GQ carrier are S7 genotypes, illustrating site vs genotype confidence.

assertions.text: Allele balance is derived from AD rather than read from a nonexistent AB tag
QUAL (site) and GQ (genotype) are treated as different quantities
Deviant AB is read as artifact/contamination signal, not biology, per the Skill
Missing genotypes are excluded from the AB computation

inputs.label: Missing vs hom-ref and PL/GQ relationship
inputs.note: SYN_S6 is ./. at 76/361 sites; counting ./. as 0/0 biases AF by up to 0.125 at a site; GQ equals min(99, PL gap) for all 2812 called genotypes.

assertions.text: No-calls are counted as missing, never as hom-ref
The AF bias of the ./.=0/0 mistake is quantified
The Skill's GQ-from-PL statement holds on the data
Two independent methods agree on missingness

inputs.execution_note: runs/in3/miss.py (cyvcf2, WSL) + bcftools GT[5]="mis" cross-check (76, identical).

inputs.label: Is this gVCF analysis-ready?
inputs.note: Recognized a gVCF: 4 records, 3 END-delimited <NON_REF> reference blocks covering 1229 bp and one candidate site (1026 G>C,<NON_REF>); the 1201-1230 block has DP 3 / GQ 0, i.e. no confident hom-ref. Advised joint genotyping before filtering or counting.

assertions.text: The file is identified as a gVCF intermediate, not a callset
END is used for record spans
Low-GQ reference blocks are not treated as confident hom-ref
Joint genotyping, not bcftools merge, is recommended

inputs.label: Convert/index/region query, gzip failure, Python filtered write
inputs.note: BCF and tabix outputs, region query (32 records), cyvcf2 region fetch (32) and QUAL>30 Writer (350/361) all ran; the plain-gzip failure was diagnosed with the bgzip fix, although the error text differs from the Skill's table.

assertions.text: Conversion, indexing and region query work as written
gzip-vs-bgzip failure is diagnosed with the right fix
Filtered write inherits the header and filters on site-level QUAL
The Common Errors table predicts the observed message
assertions.note: table says 'no BGZF EOF marker'; bcftools 1.24 says 'not compressed with bgzip'

key_strengths: Governing principle (read the level and the Number before the value) prevents the silent-wrong-number failures it lists
Field semantics verified on data: GQ from PL, Number=A/R/G, cyvcf2 gt_types codes, missing vs hom-ref
gVCF <NON_REF>/END model explained well enough to stop an agent counting reference blocks as variants
Every code block ran unmodified on bcftools 1.24 and cyvcf2 0.34

recommendations.title: Wrong bcftools query -H tip in usage guide
recommendations.problem: usage-guide.md says '-H with bcftools query skips the header line'; for query -H prints a header.
recommendations.root_cause: view -H (skip header) and query -H (print header) were conflated.
recommendations.fix: Change the tip to 'bcftools view -H skips the header; bcftools query -H adds a column header'.

recommendations.title: Update the bgzip error string
recommendations.problem: Common Errors quotes 'no BGZF EOF marker'; current bcftools reports 'not compressed with bgzip' or 'not BGZF compressed, cannot index'.
recommendations.root_cause: Error text from an older htslib.
recommendations.fix: List the current messages alongside the old one.

recommendations.title: Add a gVCF variant-site extraction recipe
recommendations.problem: The gVCF section explains the model but gives no command to list candidate sites; ALT="<NON_REF>" expressions also match multi-ALT records.
recommendations.fix: Add 'bcftools view -i "N_ALT>1" sample.g.vcf' and note that string tests on ALT match any allele.
